boards.title: MC — FPGA motion card
boards.summary: 70 source-backed FPGA-core parts on the proposed IS-1 card format. This is an initial placement study, not a complete motion-card implementation. Two package footprints are review-only assignments; the electrical sources are unchanged.
boards.outline_status: 220 × 100 mm proposed IS-1 card format; 1.6 mm thickness is a study assumption, not qualified stackup.
open_work: Card-local rail generation, supervisors and card identity are not populated in this study.
Dual watchdogs are a separate unintegrated candidate; startup conditioning and permission/self-test latches remain open.
Ioff buffers, connectors and final net allocation have not been implemented here.
No eight/twelve-motor runtime qualification follows from this placement.
All placement, thermal paths, BGA escape, decoupling, EMC and stackup require layout review.

boards.title: WD — dual watchdog circuit study
boards.summary: 22 source-backed parts from the new standalone watchdog candidate. This separate study is not integrated onto MC and does not define a product module.
boards.outline_status: 60 × 45 mm study canvas only; not an adopted product board. 1.6 mm thickness is an assumption.
open_work: FPGA configuration pull-ups defeat current 100k input pulls; startup conditioning is unresolved.
SET1 LOW qualification and complete arm / permission / self-test path are unresolved.
Timing and thermal-pad / stencil geometry have not been physically qualified.
No motion-card integration, routing or manufacturing release is implied.
